title: Due Day Changes, Plan Switches and Recurring Authorizations by Plan — Installment Payment Plans
content:
Policy service desk reference table for the **Installment Payment Plans**: what each plan allows in mid-term changes to the due day or the plan, and what recurring payment authorization it requires.

| Plan | Due day change allowed | Largest shift of the due day (calendar days, earlier or later) | Due day changes per term | Minimum calendar days between the request and the next due date | Plans it may be switched to mid-term | Mid-term switches per term | Recurring authorization required | Recurring method | Authorization lead time before a draft date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | 0 | no | none | 0 |
| Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | Paid-in-Full Plan | 1 | no | none | 0 |
| Cardinal Point Four-Pay Plan | yes | 10 | 1 | 5 | Paid-in-Full Plan | 1 | no | none | 0 |
| Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan | yes | 10 | 1 | 5 | Paid-in-Full Plan, Monthly EFT Plan, Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 2 | no | none | 0 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | yes | 10 | 1 | 5 | Paid-in-Full Plan, Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 2 | yes | bank account (ACH) | 3 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | yes | 10 | 1 | 5 | Paid-in-Full Plan, Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, Monthly EFT Plan | 2 | yes | debit or credit card | 3 |

The plan names in the switch column are the Cardinal Point plans of those names. The authorization lead time is the number of calendar days before a draft date by which a new or changed recurring authorization must be signed to apply to that draft.

**Hypothetical reading.** On the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan a customer whose next installment is due on the 20th may move the due day by at most 10 calendar days in either direction, once in the term, with the request made at least 5 calendar days before the 20th. A Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan customer moving to the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan signs a card authorization at least 3 calendar days before the next draft date for it to apply to that draft.
